title: The Ethical Compass of the Machine: Evaluating Large Language Models for Decision Support in Construction Project Management
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measured the ethical reasoning of LLMs in the context of construction project management, focusing on domains like legal compliance, fairness, accountability, transparency, and safety.
base_benchmarks: EU's Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
